context_requirements: Functional GABA-A or GABA-B receptor expression on the assayed cell line
Neuronal or endocrine lineage with intact GABAergic signal transduction
Membrane depolarization or cAMP coupling capable of altering transcription within 6-24 h
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that matches known GABA receptor antagonist activity
Enrichment of GABA-receptor pathway genes among differentially expressed landmark genes
